description: Stylers International Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 27 November 1991 and converted into a public limited company with effect from 21 May 2021; its shares were listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange on 22 January 2024. The company manufactures, markets and exports ready-made garments and provides processing services, from its plant on Ferozepur Road in Lahore.
headOffice: 20-km, Ferozepur Road, Glaxo Town, Lahore, Pakistan
